/* browser */
.browser{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(220px,300px) minmax(0,1fr);gap:18px;margin-top:10px}
.itemlist{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;max-height:560px;overflow:auto;border:1px solid var(--rule);border-radius:6px}
.itemlist button{font:inherit;font-size:14px;width:100%;text-align:left;min-height:44px;padding:7px 10px;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule2);background:#fff;cursor:pointer;color:var(--ink);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px}
.itemlist button[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--accent-soft);box-shadow:inset 4px 0 0 var(--accent)}
.itemlist .sd{color:var(--muted);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;flex:none}
.chip{display:inline-block;font-size:13px;padding:1px 7px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--rule)}
.chip.pass{background:#e3f3ea;border-color:#9bd0b1}.chip.fail{background:#fbe9e1;border-color:#e6b29b}
.side2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px}
.side2>div{min-width:0}
.count{font-size:15px;color:var(--ink2);margin:6px 0}
.figure{margin:24px 0 0}
.figure figcaption{font-size:15px;color:var(--ink2);margin-top:8px;max-width:80ch}
ul.lims{padding-left:20px}ul.lims li{margin:0 0 8px}
footer{padding:44px 0 60px;background:var(--panel);margin-top:40px}
footer h2{font-size:22px;margin-top:28px}
dl.gloss dt{font-weight:700;margin-top:10px}
dl.gloss dd{margin:2px 0 0 0;color:var(--ink2);font-size:16px}
.prov li{margin-bottom:6px;font-size:16px}
.sr{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0 0 0 0);white-space:nowrap}
@media (max-width:860px){
  .finding{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .browser{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .itemlist{max-height:300px}
  .two{grid-template-columns:1fr}
}
@media (max-width:640px){
  body{font-size:17px}
  .wrap{padding:0 16px}
  nav.sections ul{padding:0 8px}
  .view{padding:16px 14px}
  .io{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .side2{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .stages{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}
  header.top{padding-top:32px}
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<a class="skip" href="#main">Skip to main content</a>
<header class="top">
  <div class="wrap">
    <p class="kicker">Interactive explainer of the paper</p>
    <h1>Steering a 3B Code Model Selects One Known Algorithm Rather Than Diversifying</h1>
    <p class="meta">Preregistered experiments on Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, with open prompts for path search and sorting. Every chart on this page is drawn from the run's recorded programs and result files.</p>
    <ul class="links" aria-label="Paper and documents">
      <li><a class="primary" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-8d19e3-temperature-flattens-ideas-context@main/paper.pdf">Read the paper (PDF)</a></li>
      <li><a href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-8d19e3-temperature-flattens-ideas-context@main/report.pdf">Read the full research report</a></li>
      <li><a href="https://github.com/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-8d19e3-temperature-flattens-ideas-context">Code repository</a></li>
    </ul>
  </div>
</header>
<nav class="sections" aria-label="Sections">
  <ul>
    <li><a href="#finding">The finding</a></li>
    <li><a href="#how">How it works</a></li>
    <li><a href="#explore">Explore the evidence</a></li>
    <li><a href="#try">Try it</a></li>
    <li><a href="#fails">Where it fails</a></li>
    <li><a href="#about">Links and glossary</a></li>
  </ul>
</nav>
<main id="main" tabindex="-1">

<section class="block" id="finding" aria-labelledby="h-finding">
<div class="wrap">
  <h2 id="h-finding">The finding</h2>
  <div class="finding">
    <div class="prose">
      <p>Ask Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct to <em>Implement a sorting algorithm</em> and it writes bubble sort most of the time. Activation steering is often used to push a model toward less obvious solutions. Does a steering direction that points away from the default spread the model over the algorithms it knows, or does it hand the default's share to one alternative?</p>
      <p>It hands it to one alternative. The paper builds a <button type="button" class="term" data-term="away">direction away from the mode</button> and froze, before any steered program existed, the strengths, the decision rules and which family should gain. On a <button type="button" class="term" data-term="redraw">redraw</button> with fresh seeds, sorting entropy over algorithm families fell below the mean of five <button type="button" class="term" data-term="random">random directions of matched norm</button> by</p>
      <p class="bignum" id="big-num"></p>
      <p class="bigsub" id="big-sub"></p>
      <p>Lower <button type="button" class="term" data-term="entropy">idea entropy</button> than random pushes of the same size is the signature of selection, not flattening. No control in the paper produced correct code outside the textbook algorithms.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="view" id="v-hero" style="margin-top:0">
      <p class="q">Where does the default's share go when the model is steered?</p>
      <div class="controls">
        <div class="ctl"><span class="lab" id="hero-task-l">Prompt</span>
          <div class="tabs" role="tablist" aria-labelledby="hero-task-l" id="hero-task"></div></div>
      </div>
      <fieldset class="fs"><legend>Conditions shown (n programs each)</legend>
        <div class="checks" id="hero-conds"></div></fieldset>
      <ul class="legend" id="hero-legend" aria-label="Legend"></ul>
      <div class="chart" id="hero-chart"></div>
      <p class="takeaway" id="hero-take" aria-live="polite"></p>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
</section>

<section class="block" id="how" aria-labelledby="h-how">
<div class="wrap">
  <h2 id="h-how">How it works</h2>
  <p class="prose">One real program pair, followed through the six stages of the preregistered test. The example is the lowest seed on the sorting prompt where the unsteered model wrote bubble sort, the steered model wrote quicksort, and both programs passed the oracle. Use the buttons, the stage markers or the left and right arrow keys.</p>
  <div class="view stepper" id="v-step" tabindex="-1">
    <p class="q">What happens to one program, stage by stage?</p>
    <div id="step-svg" role="img" aria-label="Pipeline of six stages: label, build the direction, freeze, steer, compare with random directions, decide. The current stage is highlighted."></div>
    <ol class="stages" id="step-markers" aria-label="Stages"></ol>
    <div class="stagebody" id="step-body"></div>
    <div class="stepnav">
      <button type="button" class="btn" id="step-prev">Previous stage</button>
      <span class="small muted" id="step-pos"></span>
      <button type="button" class="btn solid" id="step-next">Next stage</button>
    </div>
    <p class="sr" aria-live="polite" id="step-live"></p>
  </div>
  <figure class="figure">
    <img src="figures/fig2_v0.jpg" width="3087" height="1335" alt="Three-panel schematic. Label and read: programs from the prompt Implement a sorting algorithm are split into the modal family, bubble sort, and non-modal families; mean activations at layers 32 to 34 over the commitment window are subtracted to give the away-from-mode direction v. Steer: alpha times v is added to layers 32 to 34 at the final prompt token and first 64 generated tokens, with comparators listed and a padlock showing the frozen strengths and rules. Select or flatten: a flat bar chart labelled FLATTEN and a chart with one tall orange bar labelled SELECT and predicted gainer." loading="lazy">
    <figcaption><strong>Figure 2 of the paper.</strong> Schematic illustration of the method (no data). Left (<em>Label and read</em>): programs sampled from the bare prompt <em>Implement a sorting algorithm</em> are labelled by algorithm family and executed on 50 tests. Mean residual-stream activations over each program's commitment window at layers 32&ndash;34 are taken for the modal programs (bubble sort, grey) and the non-modal programs (quick, merge, &hellip;). Their difference gives the away-from-mode direction <i>v</i> (orange). Middle (<em>Steer</em>): &alpha;<i>v</i> is added to layers 32&ndash;34 (orange blocks) at the final prompt token and the first 64 generated tokens (orange cells), at strengths frozen in advance together with the decision rules and the predicted gainer (padlock, frozen by hash). The comparators are five matched-norm random directions, an off-target direction, temperature 1.0 and 1.3, steering toward an off-menu centroid, and naming the family in the prompt. Right (<em>Select or flatten?</em>): the two pre-registered outcomes, drawn without values. In FLATTEN, the default's share spreads evenly over many families; in SELECT, it goes to one predicted family (orange bar).</figcaption>
  </figure>
</div>
</section>

<section class="block" id="explore" aria-labelledby="h-explore">
<div class="wrap">
  <h2 id="h-explore">Explore the evidence</h2>
  <div class="view" id="v-random">
    <p class="q">Is the targeted direction special, or would any push of the same size do this?</p>
    <div class="controls">
      <div class="ctl"><span class="lab" id="rnd-task-l">Prompt</span><div class="tabs" role="tablist" aria-labelledby="rnd-task-l" id="rnd-task"></div></div>
      <div class="ctl"><span class="lab" id="rnd-set-l">Targeted setting</span><div class="seg" role="radiogroup" aria-labelledby="rnd-set-l" id="rnd-set"></div></div>
      <label class="ctl"><span class="lab">Measure</span>
        <select id="rnd-metric">
          <option value="H_mm">Idea entropy, Miller–Madow (bits)</option>
          <option value="nonmode_share">Nonmodal share (fraction)</option>
          <option value="pass">Pass rate (fraction)</option>
        </select></label>
    </div>
    <ul class="legend" id="rnd-legend" aria-label="Legend"></ul>
    <div class="chart" id="rnd-chart"></div>
    <div class="readout" id="rnd-readout"></div>
    <p class="takeaway" id="rnd-take" aria-live="polite"></p>
  </div>

  <div class="view" id="v-items">
    <p class="q">What does steering do to one program? The same seed, under two conditions.</p>
    <p class="small muted prose">Every condition uses one seeded sampler, so a seed sees the same random numbers everywhere: a pair below differs only by the intervention. Each response is shown up to its first 900 characters; labels, oracle results and token counts are for the full program.</p>
    <div class="controls">
      <div class="ctl"><span class="lab" id="it-task-l">Prompt</span><div class="tabs" role="tablist" aria-labelledby="it-task-l" id="it-task"></div></div>
      <label class="ctl"><span class="lab">Left: condition A</span><select id="it-a"></select></label>
      <label class="ctl"><span class="lab">Right: condition B</span><select id="it-b"></select></label>
    </div>
    <div class="controls">
      <div class="ctl"><span class="lab" id="it-filter-l">Show seeds</span><div class="seg" role="radiogroup" aria-labelledby="it-filter-l" id="it-filter"></div></div>
      <label class="ctl"><span class="lab">Search a family</span><input type="search" id="it-search" placeholder="e.g. quick, A*, merge" autocomplete="off"></label>
      <label class="ctl"><span class="lab">Sort by</span><select id="it-sort"><option value="seed">Seed</option><option value="ntB">Tokens in B (most first)</option><option value="prefix">Shared opening (longest first)</option></select></label>
    </div>
    <p class="count" id="it-count" aria-live="polite"></p>
    <div class="browser">
      <ul class="itemlist" id="it-list" aria-label="Seeds"></ul>
      <div id="it-detail"></div>
    </div>
    <p class="takeaway" id="it-take" aria-live="polite"></p>
  </div>

  <div class="view" id="v-bans">
    <p class="q">Does a prompt that forbids one algorithm just remove it, or does it reshuffle the rest?</p>
    <div class="controls">
      <div class="ctl"><span class="lab" id="ban-task-l">Prompt</span><div class="tabs" role="tablist" aria-labelledby="ban-task-l" id="ban-task"></div></div>
      <label class="ctl"><span class="lab">Negative instruction</span><select id="ban-sel"></select></label>
    </div>
    <p class="small" id="ban-prompt"></p>
    <ul class="legend" id="ban-legend" aria-label="Legend"></ul>
    <div class="chart" id="ban-chart"></div>
    <p class="takeaway" id="ban-take" aria-live="polite"></p>
  </div>
</div>
</section>

<section class="block" id="try" aria-labelledby="h-try">
<div class="wrap">
  <h2 id="h-try">Try it</h2>
  <p class="prose">The method needs a 3B model's activations, so it cannot run in a browser. These two views let you turn the knobs over the recorded runs instead: every setting the slider reaches was actually sampled, and nothing between them is interpolated.</p>
  <div class="view" id="v-temp">
    <p class="q">Is temperature the creativity knob? Does it add ideas, or only new wordings of the same ideas?</p>
    <div class="controls">
      <div class="ctl"><span class="lab" id="tp-task-l">Prompt</span><div class="tabs" role="tablist" aria-labelledby="tp-task-l" id="tp-task"></div></div>
      <div class="ctl"><span class="lab" id="tp-k-l">Top-<i>k</i></span><div class="seg" role="radiogroup" aria-labelledby="tp-k-l" id="tp-k"></div></div>
      <div class="ctl rangebox"><label class="lab" for="tp-T">Sampling temperature</label>
        <input type="range" id="tp-T" min="0" max="5" step="1" value="0" aria-valuetext="T = 0.3">
        <span>T = <output class="rangeval" id="tp-Tval" for="tp-T"></output></span></div>
    </div>
    <div class="two">
      <div><h4>Distinct ideas and phrasings among ten programs</h4><ul class="legend" id="tp-legend1" aria-label="Legend"></ul><div class="chart" id="tp-chart1"></div></div>
      <div><h4>Pass rate</h4><ul class="legend" id="tp-legend2" aria-label="Legend"></ul><div class="chart" id="tp-chart2"></div></div>
    </div>
    <h4 style="margin-top:14px">Algorithm families at the selected temperature</h4>
    <ul class="legend" id="tp-legend3" aria-label="Legend"></ul>
    <div class="chart" id="tp-chart3"></div>
    <div class="readout" id="tp-readout"></div>
    <p class="takeaway" id="tp-take" aria-live="polite"></p>
  </div>

  <div class="view" id="v-strength">
    <p class="q">How were the steering strengths chosen, and what if the correctness bar had been set differently?</p>
    <p class="small prose">Before the main runs, each strength α was tried on 30 programs. The frozen rule set <button type="button" class="term" data-term="s1s2">s<sub>1</sub> and s<sub>2</sub></button>: s<sub>2</sub> is the α with the lowest mode share whose pass rate stays at least a fixed fraction (0.8) of the baseline's, ties going to the larger α. Move the bar and the page reapplies that rule to the recorded calibration runs.</p>
    <div class="controls">
      <div class="ctl"><span class="lab" id="st-task-l">Prompt</span><div class="tabs" role="tablist" aria-labelledby="st-task-l" id="st-task"></div></div>
      <div class="ctl rangebox"><label class="lab" for="st-bar">Pass-rate bar, as a fraction of the baseline pass rate</label>
        <input type="range" id="st-bar" min="0.5" max="1" step="0.05" value="0.8">
        <span>bar = <output class="rangeval" id="st-barval" for="st-bar"></output> × baseline</span></div>
    </div>
    <ul class="legend" id="st-legend" aria-label="Legend"></ul>
    <div class="chart" id="st-chart"></div>
    <div class="readout" id="st-readout"></div>
    <p class="takeaway" id="st-take" aria-live="polite"></p>
  </div>
</div>
</section>

<section class="block" id="fails" aria-labelledby="h-fails">
<div class="wrap">
  <h2 id="h-fails">Where it fails</h2>
  <div class="view" id="v-fail">
    <p class="q">What does selection cost in correctness?</p>
    <div class="controls">
      <div class="ctl"><span class="lab" id="fl-task-l">Prompt</span><div class="tabs" role="tablist" aria-labelledby="fl-task-l" id="fl-task"></div></div>
      <div class="ctl"><span class="lab" id="fl-m-l">Show</span><div class="seg" role="radiogroup" aria-labelledby="fl-m-l" id="fl-m"></div></div>
      <button type="button" class="btn" id="fl-open">Open the failing programs in the browser</button>
    </div>
    <ul class="legend" id="fl-legend" aria-label="Legend"></ul>
    <div class="chart" id="fl-chart"></div>
    <p class="takeaway" id="fl-take" aria-live="polite"></p>
  </div>
  <div class="view" id="v-off">
    <p class="q">Can steering reach an algorithm the model never writes on its own?</p>
    <div class="controls">
      <div class="ctl"><span class="lab" id="off-l">Target family (absent from the baseline)</span><div class="seg" role="radiogroup" aria-labelledby="off-l" id="off-sel"></div></div>
    </div>
    <ul class="legend" id="off-legend" aria-label="Legend"></ul>
    <div class="chart" id="off-chart"></div>
    <p class="takeaway" id="off-take" aria-live="polite"></p>
  </div>
  <div class="prose">
    <h3>What the paper does not show</h3>
    <ul class="lims">
      <li>The selection result is measured on one model, Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, and two prompts, each with one wording. The steering test was not run on gemma-2-2b-it, where the negative-instruction results did not reproduce the Qwen pattern.</li>
      <li>The SELECT rule accepted the top prediction of either of two frozen rankings, which loosens it, and on path search the s<sub>2</sub> operating point missed the frozen pass-rate bar (0.17 against 0.25).</li>
      <li>On path search the labeller agrees with a blind judge at kappa 0.39 on steered outputs, so the exact A* share is uncertain; the sorting result, at kappa 0.94, is the cleaner of the two.</li>
      <li>Novelty was measured as correct code outside known algorithm families, which is near zero by construction on textbook tasks. The result says these controls did not create new algorithms for path search and sorting, not that steering cannot raise novelty on open problems.</li>
      <li>The layer band was chosen by a probe whose accuracy was flat across layers, and the window covers the first 64 generated tokens; other bands or windows may flatten where this one selects.</li>
      <li>The point at which the model commits to an idea is not located: probes on the first eight generated tokens were at chance.</li>
      <li>Truncation affects labels: continuing 150 truncated programs flipped 10.7% of labels in the temperature experiments, and batch composition alone flips 11% to 17% of labels in repeated runs.</li>
    </ul>
  </div>
</div>
</section>
</main>

<footer id="about" aria-labelledby="h-about">
  <div class="wrap">
    <h2 id="h-about" style="margin-top:0">Paper, report and code</h2>
    <ul class="links" aria-label="Paper and documents (footer)">
      <li><a class="primary" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-8d19e3-temperature-flattens-ideas-context@main/paper.pdf">Read the paper (PDF)</a></li>
      <li><a href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-8d19e3-temperature-flattens-ideas-context@main/report.pdf">Read the full research report</a></li>
      <li><a href="https://github.com/ai-inventor-papers/ai-invention-8d19e3-temperature-flattens-ideas-context">Code repository</a></li>
    </ul>
    <h2>Where each view's data comes from</h2>
    <ul class="prov prose">
      <li><strong>The finding, the random-direction comparison, the stepper, the strength rule, the correctness and off-menu views:</strong> <code>experiment_6/results/selector_tables.json</code> (per-condition counts, pass rates, entropies, bootstrap differences and CIs, frozen rankings, calibration runs, rule verdicts) and <code>experiment_6/results/frozen_selector_qwen_alphas.json</code> (calibration mode shares and pass rates).</li>
      <li><strong>The program browser and the stepper's example:</strong> <code>experiment_6/full_method_out.json</code>, Qwen datasets, seeds 0 to 149 of the baseline and of the steered and random conditions. Responses are cut to their first 900 characters for size; labels and oracle results are from the file. Random draws 2 to 5 and the temperature cells carry labels only.</li>
      <li><strong>Temperature:</strong> <code>experiment_4/results/temperature_law_redraw.json</code> (cells and the ideas-against-phrasings table, fresh-seed redraw, n = 100 per cell).</li>
      <li><strong>Negative instructions:</strong> <code>experiment_5/full_method_out.json</code> (labels of the confirmation programs, counted per condition, three placebo blocks pooled) and <code>experiment_5/results/regularity.json</code> (Fisher tests with Holm correction).</li>
    </ul>
    <h2>Glossary</h2>
    <dl class="gloss prose" id="gloss"></dl>
  </div>
</footer>
<div id="tip" role="status" aria-live="polite"></div>
<div id="termtip"></div>

<script>
"use strict";
(function(){
const D = id => JSON.parse(document.getElementById(id).textContent);
const STEER = D("data-steer"), ITEMS = D("data-items"), TEMP = D("data-temperature"), BANS = D("data-bans");
const SVGNS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";

/* ---------- names ---------- */
const FAM = {BFS:"BFS",DFS:"DFS",Dijkstra:"Dijkstra",A_star:"A*",SPFA:"SPFA",IDDFS:"IDDFS",Bellman_Ford:"Bellman-Ford",
  Greedy_best_first:"Greedy best-first",Bidirectional:"Bidirectional",Floyd_Warshall:"Floyd-Warshall",Other:"Other",
  Unparseable:"Unparseable",Bubble:"Bubble sort",Quick:"Quicksort",Merge:"Merge sort",Selection:"Selection sort",
  Insertion:"Insertion sort",Heap:"Heap sort",Counting:"Counting sort",Radix:"Radix sort",Shell:"Shell sort",
  Tim_hybrid:"Timsort / hybrid",Bucket:"Bucket sort",Builtin:"Built-in sort"};
const fam = k => FAM[k] || String(k).replace(/_/g," ");
const TASKS = [["T1","Path search"],["T2","Sorting"]];
const TASKNAME = {T1:"path search",T2:"sorting"};
const PALETTE = {
  T1:[["BFS","#a3a3a3"],["A_star","#E69F00"],["DFS","#56B4E9"],["Dijkstra","#3fb68f"]],
  T2:[["Bubble","#a3a3a3"],["Quick","#E69F00"],["Merge","#56B4E9"],["Selection","#3fb68f"],["Insertion","#e09ac4"]]
};
const REST = "#eeece6";
const COND = {
  baseline:["Baseline","Baseline (no steering)"],
  rand_mean_s2:["Random, mean of 5","Five random directions at s₂, pooled"],
  rand0_s2:["Random draw 1","Random direction 1 at s₂"],rand1_s2:["Random draw 2","Random direction 2 at s₂"],
  rand2_s2:["Random draw 3","Random direction 3 at s₂"],rand3_s2:["Random draw 4","Random direction 4 at s₂"],
  rand4_s2:["Random draw 5","Random direction 5 at s₂"],
  away_s1:["Away, s₁","Away from mode at s₁"],away_s1_redraw:["Away, s₁, redraw","Away from mode at s₁, redraw"],
  away_s2:["Away, s₂","Away from mode at s₂"],away_s2_redraw:["Away, s₂, redraw","Away from mode at s₂, redraw"],
  off_s2:["Other task's dir., s₂","Other task's direction at s₂"],
  "temp1.0":["Temperature 1.0","Temperature 1.0"],"temp1.3":["Temperature 1.3","Temperature 1.3"]
};
const cshort = k => (COND[k]||[k,k])[0], clong = k => (COND[k]||[k,k])[1];

/* ---------- helpers ---------- */
const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
function h(tag, attrs, ...kids){ const e=document.createElement(tag); for(const k in (attrs||{})){ if(k==="text") e.textContent=attrs[k]; else if(k==="html") e.innerHTML=attrs[k]; else e.setAttribute(k,attrs[k]); } kids.flat().forEach(c=>{ if(c!=null) e.append(c); }); return e; }
function s(tag, attrs, parent){ const e=document.createElementNS(SVGNS,tag); for(const k in (attrs||{})){ if(k==="text") e.textContent=attrs[k]; else e.setAttribute(k,attrs[k]); } if(parent) parent.appendChild(e); return e; }
const esc = t => String(t).replace(/[&<>"]/g,c=>({"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;"}[c]));
const pct = (x,d=1) => (100*x).toFixed(d)+"%";
const f2 = x => (x<0?"−":"")+Math.abs(x).toFixed(2);
const f3 = x => (x<0?"−":"")+Math.abs(x).toFixed(3);
const sg2 = x => (x>0?"+":x<0?"−":"")+Math.abs(x).toFixed(2);
const ci2 = c => "["+f2(c[0])+", "+f2(c[1])+"]";
let measurer;
function textW(str, size, weight){ if(!measurer){ const sv=s("svg",{width:0,height:0,style:"position:absolute;left:-9999px;top:0"}); document.body.appendChild(sv); measurer=s("text",{},sv);} measurer.setAttribute("font-size",size); measurer.setAttribute("font-weight",weight||400); measurer.setAttribute("font-family",getComputedStyle(document.body).fontFamily); measurer.textContent=str; return measurer.getComputedTextLength(); }
function niceTicks(lo, hi, n){ const span=hi-lo, step0=span/n, mag=Math.pow(10,Math.floor(Math.log10(step0))); const st=[1,2,2.5,5,10].map(m=>m*mag).find(v=>v>=step0); const out=[]; for(let v=Math.ceil(lo/st-1e-9)*st; v<=hi+1e-9; v+=st) out.push(+v.toFixed(10)); return out; }
function legend(ul, items){ ul.innerHTML=""; items.forEach(([lab,col,shape])=>{ const sw=h("span",{class:"sw","aria-hidden":"true"}); if(shape==="line"){ sw.style.height="3px"; sw.style.border="0"; sw.style.background=col; } else if(shape==="dash"){ sw.style.height="0"; sw.style.border="0"; sw.style.borderTop="2px dashed "+col; sw.style.width="18px"; } else if(shape==="dot"){ sw.style.borderRadius="50%"; sw.style.background=col; } else if(shape==="ring"){ sw.style.borderRadius="50%"; sw.style.background="#fff"; sw.style.border="2px solid "+col; } else sw.style.background=col; ul.append(h("li",{},sw,h("span",{text:lab}))); }); }

/* tablists and radio groups */
function tabs(container, options, current, onChange){
  container.innerHTML="";
  const btns = options.map(([v,lab])=>{ const b=h("button",{type:"button",role:"tab","aria-selected":String(v===current),tabindex:v===current?"0":"-1",text:lab}); b.dataset.v=v; container.append(b); return b; });
  function select(v, focus){ btns.forEach(b=>{ const on=b.dataset.v===v; b.setAttribute("aria-selected",String(on)); b.tabIndex=on?0:-1; if(on&&focus) b.focus(); }); onChange(v); }
  btns.forEach((b,i)=>{ b.addEventListener("click",()=>select(b.dataset.v)); b.addEventListener("keydown",e=>{ let j=null; if(e.key==="ArrowRight") j=(i+1)%btns.length; if(e.key==="ArrowLeft") j=(i-1+btns.length)%btns.length; if(j!=null){ e.preventDefault(); select(btns[j].dataset.v,true);} }); });
  return {set:v=>select(v)};
}
function radios(container, options, current, onChange){
  container.innerHTML="";
  const btns = options.map(([v,lab])=>{ const b=h("button",{type:"button",role:"radio","aria-checked":String(v===current),tabindex:v===current?"0":"-1"}); b.innerHTML=lab; b.dataset.v=v; container.append(b); return b; });
  function select(v, focus){ btns.forEach(b=>{ const on=b.dataset.v===v; b.setAttribute("aria-checked",String(on)); b.tabIndex=on?0:-1; if(on&&focus) b.focus(); }); onChange(v); }
  btns.forEach((b,i)=>{ b.addEventListener("click",()=>select(b.dataset.v)); b.addEventListener("keydown",e=>{ let j=null; if(e.key==="ArrowRight"||e.key==="ArrowDown") j=(i+1)%btns.length; if(e.key==="ArrowLeft"||e.key==="ArrowUp") j=(i-1+btns.length)%btns.length; if(j!=null){ e.preventDefault(); select(btns[j].dataset.v,true);} }); });
  return {set:v=>select(v), buttons:btns};
}

/* ---------- chart tooltip ---------- */
const tip = $("tip"); let tipOwner=null;
function showTip(target, html, evt){
  tip.innerHTML = html; tip.style.display="block"; tipOwner=target;
  const r = target.getBoundingClientRect(); const tw=tip.offsetWidth, th=tip.offsetHeight;
  let x = (evt && evt.clientX!=null && evt.type!=="focus" ? evt.clientX : r.left + r.width/2) + window.scrollX - tw/2;
  let y = r.top + window.scrollY - th - 10;
  if (y < window.scrollY + 4) y = r.bottom + window.scrollY + 10;
  x = Math.max(window.scrollX+8, Math.min(x, window.scrollX + document.documentElement.clientWidth - tw - 8));
  tip.style.left = x+"px"; tip.style.top = y+"px";
}
function hideTip(){ tip.style.display="none"; tipOwner=null; }
function markify(el, label, html){
  el.setAttribute("tabindex","0"); el.setAttribute("role","img"); el.setAttribute("aria-label",label); el.classList.add("mark");
  el.addEventListener("pointerenter",e=>showTip(el,html,e));
  el.addEventListener("pointermove",e=>{ if(e.pointerType==="mouse") showTip(el,html,e); });
  el.addEventListener("pointerleave",e=>{ if(e.pointerType==="mouse") hideTip(); });
  el.addEventListener("focus",e=>showTip(el,html,e));
  el.addEventListener("blur",hideTip);
  el.addEventListener("click",e=>{ e.stopPropagation(); showTip(el,html,e); });
}
document.addEventListener("pointerdown",e=>{ if(tipOwner && !tipOwner.contains(e.target)) hideTip(); });

/* ---------- term tooltips ---------- */
const GLOSS = {
  idea:["Idea","The algorithm family a program implements. Each program is labelled with one family by a deterministic labeller."],
  menu:["Menu","The set of ideas present in a prompt's baseline sample."],
  mode:["Mode","The most frequent idea at baseline: BFS on path search, bubble sort on sorting."],
  nonmodal:["Nonmodal share","One minus the share of the mode: the fraction of programs not implementing the baseline default."],
  entropy:["Idea entropy","The Shannon entropy of the idea distribution in bits, with the Miller–Madow correction when conditions of different size are compared."],
  away:["Direction away from the mode","The difference in means between residual-stream activations of programs that do not and do implement the mode, over the commitment window at layers 32 to 34, normalised to unit length. During generation it is added, scaled by the strength α, at the final prompt token and the first 64 generated tokens."],
  window:["Commitment window","The 17 generated tokens starting at the first token that names or implements the idea, or the first 32 generated tokens when no such token exists."],
  random:["Random directions of matched norm","Five random directions added at the same strength as the targeted one. The comparison statistic is the targeted value minus the mean over the five draws, with a hierarchical bootstrap over draws and programs."],
  s1s2:["Steering strengths s₁ and s₂","Calibrated on separate runs of 30 programs and frozen: s₁ is the α whose mode share is closest to half the baseline mode share, and s₂ the α with the lowest mode share whose pass rate stays at least 0.8 times the baseline's."],
  gainer:["Predicted gainer","The top idea of either frozen ranking: the projection of the direction onto each idea centroid's offset from the modal centroid, or the similarity of each centroid to the modal centroid (nearest neighbour)."],
  select:["SELECT and FLATTEN","SELECT: at s₂ one nonmodal idea takes at least half the programs, that idea is a predicted gainer, and the distance from the uniform distribution rises again from s₁ to s₂. FLATTEN: the distance from uniform falls from baseline to s₁ to s₂, and no nonmodal idea reaches half the programs."],
  redraw:["Redraw","A repeat of the steered conditions with fresh seeds 1000 to 1149, after the main draw on seeds 0 to 149."],
  oracle:["Oracle (pass)","A sandboxed execution oracle. A program counts as correct only if it passes every test case: 50 random graphs and 25 grids for path search, 50 lists for sorting."],
  offtarget:["Other task's direction","The direction away from the mode built on the other prompt (sorting for path search and the reverse), used as an off-target real direction."],
  phrasing:["Phrasing","Two programs share a phrasing when their normalised code has edit distance similarity of at least 0.85."],
  rarefy:["Expected ideas among ten","The expected number of distinct ideas in a random draw of ten programs from a cell, a rarefaction of richness; the same count for phrasings gives expected phrasings among ten."],
  topk:["Top-k","Sampling restricted to the k most probable next tokens. The temperature sweep ran with top-k 10 or with no top-k."],
  regularity:["Regularity","Removing an option from a choice set should never lower the share of an option that remains. A significant drop of a family the instruction did not name is a violation."],
  placebo:["Placebo prompt","A prompt that appends a negative instruction against an irrelevant algorithm (Do not use the Rabin-Karp algorithm. for path search, Do not use Kruskal's algorithm. for sorting)."],
  cap:["Token cap","Steering runs stop at 768 generated tokens; a program that reaches the cap is truncated."]
};
const gl = $("gloss");
Object.entries(GLOSS).forEach(([k,[t,d]])=>{ gl.append(h("dt",{id:"gt-"+k,text:t}), h("dd",{id:"g-"+k,text:d})); });
const termtip=$("termtip"); let termOwner=null;
function openTerm(btn){
  const k=btn.dataset.term; const g=GLOSS[k]; if(!g) return;
  termtip.innerHTML="<strong>"+esc(g[0])+"</strong>"+esc(g[1]); termtip.style.display="block"; termOwner=btn;
  const r=btn.getBoundingClientRect(); const tw=termtip.offsetWidth;
  let x=r.left+window.scrollX; x=Math.max(window.scrollX+8,Math.min(x,window.scrollX+document.documentElement.clientWidth-tw-8));
  termtip.style.left=x+"px"; termtip.style.top=(r.bottom+window.scrollY+8)+"px";
}
function closeTerm(){ termtip.style.display="none"; termOwner=null; }
function wireTerms(root){
  root.querySelectorAll("button.term:not([data-wired])").forEach(b=>{
    b.dataset.wired="1"; b.setAttribute("aria-describedby","g-"+b.dataset.term); b.setAttribute("aria-expanded","false");
    const open=()=>{ openTerm(b); b.setAttribute("aria-expanded","true"); };
    b.addEventListener("mouseenter",open); b.addEventListener("focus",open);
    b.addEventListener("click",e=>{ e.stopPropagation(); open(); });
    b.addEventListener("mouseleave",()=>{ if(termOwner===b && document.activeElement!==b){ closeTerm(); b.setAttribute("aria-expanded","false"); } });
  });
}
wireTerms(document);
document.addEventListener("pointerdown",e=>{ if(termOwner && !termOwner.contains(e.target) && !termtip.contains(e.target)){ termOwner.setAttribute("aria-expanded","false"); closeTerm(); } });
document.addEventListener("keydown",e=>{ if(e.key==="Escape"){ if(termOwner){ termOwner.setAttribute("aria-expanded","false"); closeTerm(); } hideTip(); } });
window.addEventListener("scroll",()=>{ if(tipOwner && !tipOwner.matches(":focus")) hideTip(); },{passive:true});

/* ---------- shared data helpers ---------- */
function cell(t, k){
  const T = STEER.tasks[t];
  if(k==="rand_mean_s2"){
    const counts={}; let n=0, pw=0, H=[];
    for(let i=0;i<5;i++){ const c=T.cells["rand"+i+"_s2"]; n+=c.n; pw+=c.pass_rate*c.n; for(const f in c.counts) counts[f]=(counts[f]||0)+c.counts[f]; }
    return {n, counts, pass_rate:pw/n, pooled:true};
  }
  return T.cells[k];
}
function stackRows(t, counts, n){
  const named = PALETTE[t].map(([k,col])=>({key:k,label:fam(k),col,v:(counts[k]||0)/n,c:counts[k]||0}));
  const restKeys = Object.keys(counts).filter(k=>!PALETTE[t].some(p=>p[0]===k));
  const restC = restKeys.reduce((a,k)=>a+counts[k],0);
  const restDetail = restKeys.sort((a,b)=>counts[b]-counts[a]).map(k=>fam(k)+" "+counts[k]).join(", ");
  named.push({key:"_rest",label:"All other labels",col:REST,v:restC/n,c:restC,detail:restDetail});
  return named;
}
function legendFor(t){ return PALETTE[t].map(([k,c])=>[fam(k),c]).concat([["All other labels",REST]]); }

/* ---------- horizontal 100% stacked bars ---------- */
function hStack(container, rows, opts){
  // rows: [{label, segs:[{label,col,v,c,detail}], n, right, title}]
  container.innerHTML=""; const W=Math.max(280, container.clientWidth||600);
  const fs=13, rowH=opts.rowH||30, gap=10;
  const labW=Math.max(...rows.map(r=>textW(r.label,fs,r.bold?700:400)));
  const rightW=opts.rightHead? Math.max(textW(opts.rightHead,12,600), ...rows.map(r=>textW(r.right||"",fs,400)))+8 : 0;
  const ml=labW+12, mr=rightW+10, mt=opts.rightHead?22:6, axisH=40;
  const pw=W-ml-mr; const H=mt+rows.length*(rowH+gap)+axisH;
  const sv=s("svg",{viewBox:`0 0 ${W} ${H}`,width:W,height:H,role:"group","aria-label":opts.aria||"Stacked bar chart"});
  const x=v=>ml+v*pw;
  [0,.25,.5,.75,1].forEach(v=>{ s("line",{x1:x(v),x2:x(v),y1:mt-4,y2:H-axisH+2,stroke:"#e4e2da"},sv); s("text",{x:x(v),y:H-axisH+16,"text-anchor":"middle","font-size":12,fill:"#4a4a46",text:Math.round(v*100)},sv); });
  s("text",{x:ml+pw/2,y:H-6,"text-anchor":"middle","font-size":12.5,fill:"#4a4a46",text:opts.xTitle||"Share of programs (%)"},sv);
  if(opts.rightHead) s("text",{x:W-mr+8,y:mt-8,"font-size":12,"font-weight":600,fill:"#4a4a46",text:opts.rightHead},sv);
  rows.forEach((r,i)=>{
    const y=mt+i*(rowH+gap);
    s("text",{x:ml-10,y:y+rowH/2+4.5,"text-anchor":"end","font-size":fs,"font-weight":r.bold?700:400,text:r.label},sv);
    let acc=0;
    r.segs.forEach(sg=>{
      if(sg.v<=0){ return; }
      const g=s("g",{},sv);
      const rx=x(acc), w=sg.v*pw;
      s("rect",{x:rx,y,width:Math.max(w,0.5),height:rowH,fill:sg.col,stroke:sg.col===REST?"#c9c6bb":"#fff","stroke-width":1},g);
      const valTxt=(sg.v*100).toFixed(1);
      if(w>textW(valTxt,11.5,600)+8) s("text",{x:rx+w/2,y:y+rowH/2+4,"text-anchor":"middle","font-size":11.5,"font-weight":600,fill:"#1b1b1a","pointer-events":"none",text:valTxt},g);
      const html=`<b>${esc(sg.label)}</b><br>${esc(r.title||r.label)}<br>${(sg.v*100).toFixed(1)}% of programs (${sg.c} of ${r.n})`+(sg.detail?`<br>${esc(sg.detail)}`:"");
      markify(g, `${sg.label}, ${r.title||r.label}: ${(sg.v*100).toFixed(1)} percent, ${sg.c} of ${r.n} programs`, html);
      acc+=sg.v;
    });
    if(opts.rightHead) s("text",{x:W-mr+8,y:y+rowH/2+4.5,"font-size":fs,"font-variant-numeric":"tabular-nums",text:r.right||""},sv);
  });
  container.append(sv);
}

/* ================= HERO ================= */
const hero={task:"T2", on:{}};
const HERO_CONDS=["baseline","rand_mean_s2","away_s2","away_s2_redraw","away_s1","away_s1_redraw","off_s2","rand0_s2","rand1_s2","rand2_s2","rand3_s2","rand4_s2","temp1.0","temp1.3"];
const HERO_DEFAULT=["baseline","rand_mean_s2","away_s2","away_s2_redraw"];
HERO_CONDS.forEach(k=>hero.on[k]=HERO_DEFAULT.includes(k));
function heroChecks(){
  const box=$("hero-conds"); box.innerHTML="";
  HERO_CONDS.forEach(k=>{
    const c=cell(hero.task,k);
    const inp=h("input",{type:"checkbox",id:"hc-"+k}); inp.checked=hero.on[k]; if(k==="baseline"){ inp.disabled=true; inp.checked=true; }
    inp.addEventListener("change",()=>{ hero.on[k]=inp.checked; renderHero(); });
    box.append(h("label",{for:"hc-"+k},inp,h("span",{text:clong(k)+" ("+c.n+")"+(k==="baseline"?" · always shown":"")})));
  });
}
function renderHero(){
  const t=hero.task, T=STEER.tasks[t], mode=T.mode, gain=T.predicted_top_gainer_proj;
  legend($("hero-legend"), legendFor(t));
  const keys=HERO_CONDS.filter(k=>k==="baseline"||hero.on[k]);
  const rows=keys.map(k=>{ const c=cell(t,k); return {label:cshort(k),title:clong(k),bold:k==="baseline",n:c.n,segs:stackRows(t,c.counts,c.n),right:c.pass_rate.toFixed(2)}; });
  hStack($("hero-chart"), rows, {rightHead:"Pass",aria:`Share of programs per algorithm family on the ${TASKNAME[t]} prompt, one bar per condition`});
  const b=cell(t,"baseline"); const share=(c,f)=>(c.counts[f]||0)/c.n;
  const others=keys.filter(k=>k!=="baseline");
  let txt;
  if(!others.length){ txt=`At baseline the model writes ${fam(mode)} in ${pct(share(b,mode))} of ${TASKNAME[t]} programs and ${fam(gain)}, the frozen predicted gainer, in ${pct(share(b,gain))}. Tick a condition to compare.`; }
  else {
    const lo=others.reduce((a,k)=>share(cell(t,k),mode)<share(cell(t,a),mode)?k:a);
    const hi=others.reduce((a,k)=>share(cell(t,k),mode)>share(cell(t,a),mode)?k:a);
    const cl=cell(t,lo); const top=Object.keys(cl.counts).filter(f=>f!==mode).sort((x,y)=>cl.counts[y]-cl.counts[x])[0];
    txt=`Baseline ${fam(mode)}: ${pct(share(b,mode))}. Among the conditions shown, ${clong(lo)} moves it furthest, to ${pct(share(cl,mode))}, and one family takes the freed share: ${fam(top)} at ${pct(share(cl,top))}${top===gain?", the frozen prediction":""}. ${hi!==lo?clong(hi)+" leaves "+fam(mode)+" at "+pct(share(cell(t,hi),mode))+".":""}`;
  }
  $("hero-take").textContent=txt;
}
tabs($("hero-task"),TASKS,hero.task,v=>{ hero.task=v; heroChecks(); renderHero(); });
(function(){ const v=STEER.tasks.T2.vs_random["redraw@s2"].H_mm; const c=STEER.tasks.T2.cells;
  $("big-num").textContent=f2(v.diff)+" bits";
  $("big-sub").textContent=`95% CI ${ci2(v.ci)}; ${f3(v.target)} bits under steering against ${f3(v.random_draw_mean)} for the random mean. In the same runs bubble sort fell from ${pct(c.baseline.counts.Bubble/c.baseline.n)} of programs to ${pct((c.away_s2_redraw.counts.Bubble||0)/c.away_s2_redraw.n)} and quicksort rose to ${pct(c.away_s2_redraw.counts.Quick/c.away_s2_redraw.n)}.`;
})();

/* ================= STEPPER ================= */
const EX_T="T2";
const exSeed=(function(){ const C=ITEMS[EX_T].conds; for(let i=0;i<150;i++){ const a=C.baseline[i], b=C.away_s2[i]; if(a.l==="Bubble"&&b.l==="Quick"&&a.o==="pass"&&b.o==="pass") return i; } return 0; })();
const STAGES=[["Label","Sample and label"],["Direction","Build the direction"],["Freeze","Freeze strengths and predictions"],["Steer","Steer the same seed"],["Compare","Compare with random directions"],["Decide","Apply the frozen rule"]];
let stage=0;
function prefixLen(a,b){ let i=0; while(i<a.length&&i<b.length&&a[i]===b[i]) i++; return i; }
function codeBlock(text, same){ const pre=h("pre",{class:"code",tabindex:"0"}); if(same>0){ pre.append(h("span",{class:"same",text:text.slice(0,same)})); } pre.append(document.createTextNode(text.slice(same))); return pre; }
function io(i,d,o){ return h("div",{class:"io"},h("div",{},h("h4",{text:"Goes in"}),h("div",{html:i})),h("div",{},h("h4",{text:"What is done"}),h("div",{html:d})),h("div",{},h("h4",{text:"Comes out"}),h("div",{html:o}))); }
function stageBody(k){
  const T=STEER.tasks[EX_T], C=ITEMS[EX_T].conds, A=C.baseline[exSeed], B=C.away_s2[exSeed], cb=T.cells.baseline;
  const box=h("div");
  if(k===0){
    box.append(h("h3",{text:"1. Sample and label"}),
      io(`The bare prompt <em>${esc(ITEMS[EX_T].prompt)}</em>, temperature 0.7, seed ${exSeed}.`,
         `The model writes a program; a deterministic labeller names its <button type="button" class="term" data-term="idea">idea</button> and the <button type="button" class="term" data-term="oracle">oracle</button> runs it on 50 lists.`,
         `Label <strong>${fam(A.l)}</strong>, oracle <strong>${A.o}</strong> (pass fraction ${A.p}), ${A.nt} tokens.`),
      h("p",{class:"small muted",text:`Recorded response, seed ${exSeed}, first ${A.x.length} of ${A.full} characters:`}), codeBlock(A.x,0),
      h("p",{html:`Across all ${cb.n} baseline programs: `+Object.entries(cb.counts).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]).map(([f,c])=>`${esc(fam(f))} ${pct(c/cb.n)}`).join(", ")+`. Why: the <button type="button" class="term" data-term="mode">mode</button> (${fam(T.mode)}) and the <button type="button" class="term" data-term="menu">menu</button> come from these labels, and every later stage is measured against them.`}));
  } else if(k===1){
    const g=Object.entries(T.g_proj).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]); const mx=g[0][1];
    const bars=h("div",{class:"bars"});
    g.forEach(([f,v])=>{ const name=f.startsWith("forced:")?fam(f.slice(7))+" (asked-for programs)":fam(f); bars.append(h("span",{text:name}), h("span",{},h("span",{class:"b"+(f===T.predicted_top_gainer_proj?" hi":""),style:`width:${(100*v/mx).toFixed(1)}%;display:block`})), h("span",{class:"mono",text:v.toFixed(3)})); });
    const nn=Object.entries(T.nn_cos).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]);
    box.append(h("h3",{text:"2. Build the direction away from the mode"}),
      io(`Residual-stream activations of the ${cb.n} baseline programs, averaged over each program's <button type="button" class="term" data-term="window">commitment window</button> at layers 32 to 34 of 36.`,
         `Mean over non-${fam(T.mode)} programs minus mean over ${fam(T.mode)} programs, normalised to unit length: the <button type="button" class="term" data-term="away">direction away from the mode</button>, <i>v</i>.`,
         `<i>v</i> and its projection onto each family centroid's offset from the modal centroid. The largest projection, <strong>${fam(T.predicted_top_gainer_proj)}</strong>, becomes the predicted gainer.`),
      h("p",{class:"small muted",text:"Recorded projection ranking (frozen before steering):"}), bars,
      h("p",{text:`The competing nearest-neighbour ranking, which orders families by how close their centroid sits to the modal centroid, puts ${fam(nn[0][0].replace("forced:",""))} first. Why two rankings: they predict different winners, so the outcome tests which geometry the direction follows.`}));
  } else if(k===2){
    const cal=T.calibration; const tb=h("table",{class:"t"});
    tb.append(h("thead",{},h("tr",{},h("th",{text:"α"}),h("th",{text:`${fam(T.mode)} share`}),h("th",{text:"Pass rate"}),h("th",{text:"Role"}))));
    const tbody=h("tbody"); Object.keys(cal.mode_share_by_alpha).forEach(a=>{ const role=(+a===cal.s1?"s₁":"")+(+a===cal.s2?"s₂":""); tbody.append(h("tr",{},h("td",{text:a}),h("td",{text:pct(cal.mode_share_by_alpha[a])}),h("td",{text:cal.pass_by_alpha[a].toFixed(2)}),h("td",{text:role}))); }); tb.append(tbody);
    box.append(h("h3",{text:"3. Freeze strengths, rules and predictions"}),
      io(`Calibration runs of 30 programs at five strengths α; baseline ${fam(T.mode)} share ${pct(cal.baseline_mode_share)}, baseline pass rate ${cal.baseline_pass.toFixed(2)}.`,
         `The frozen rules pick <button type="button" class="term" data-term="s1s2">s<sub>1</sub> and s<sub>2</sub></button>, and the files holding them, the <button type="button" class="term" data-term="gainer">predicted gainers</button> and the <button type="button" class="term" data-term="select">SELECT and FLATTEN</button> rules are hashed before any steered generation.`,
         `s<sub>1</sub> = ${cal.s1}, s<sub>2</sub> = ${cal.s2}; predicted gainers ${T.predicted_gainers.map(fam).join(" and ")}.`),
      h("div",{class:"tablewrap"},tb),
      h("p",{class:"small",html:`SHA-256 of the frozen predictions file: <span class="mono">${esc(STEER.frozen_hashes["frozen_selector_qwen.json"])}</span><br>SHA-256 of the frozen strengths file: <span class="mono">${esc(STEER.frozen_hashes["frozen_selector_qwen_alphas.json"])}</span>`}),
      h("p",{text:"Why: freezing the prediction and the strength before the data exists means the result cannot be tuned after the fact. Try other correctness bars in the Try it section."}));
  } else if(k===3){
    const same=prefixLen(A.x,B.x);
    box.append(h("h3",{text:"4. Steer the same seed"}),
      io(`The same prompt and seed ${exSeed}, so the sampler draws the same random numbers as in stage 1.`,
         `Add α·<i>v</i> (α = s<sub>2</sub> = ${T.alphas.s2}, scaled by the median residual norm) at layers 32 to 34, on the final prompt token and the first 64 generated tokens.`,
         `Label <strong>${fam(B.l)}</strong>, oracle <strong>${B.o}</strong> (pass fraction ${B.p}), ${B.nt} tokens.`),
      h("p",{class:"small muted",text:`Recorded steered response, seed ${exSeed}, first ${B.x.length} of ${B.full} characters. ${same>0?"Grey text is identical to the unsteered response ("+same+" characters).":"It differs from the unsteered response from the first character."}`}), codeBlock(B.x,same),
      h("p",{text:`Why: with the randomness held fixed, the change from ${fam(A.l)} to ${fam(B.l)} is caused by the added direction. Over all 150 seeds, ${T.cells.away_s2.counts.Quick} programs are quicksort and ${T.cells.away_s2.counts.Bubble||0} bubble sort.`}));
  } else if(k===4){
    const v=T.vs_random["main@s2"].H_mm;
    const lab=[0,1,2,3,4].map(i=>`<li>Random direction ${i+1}: <strong>${esc(fam(C["rand"+i+"_s2"][exSeed].l))}</strong> (cell entropy ${v.random_per_draw[i].toFixed(3)} bits)</li>`).join("");
    box.append(h("h3",{text:"5. Compare with random directions of the same norm"}),
      io(`Five <button type="button" class="term" data-term="random">random directions of matched norm</button> at the same strength, 150 programs each, same seeds.`,
         `Compute <button type="button" class="term" data-term="entropy">idea entropy</button> for each cell and subtract the mean over the five draws; a hierarchical bootstrap (B = ${v.B.toLocaleString("en")}) gives the interval.`,
         `Steered ${v.target.toFixed(3)} bits against a random mean of ${v.random_draw_mean.toFixed(3)}: difference ${f2(v.diff)} bits, 95% CI ${ci2(v.ci)}.`),
      h("p",{html:`What the same seed ${exSeed} wrote under each random direction:</p><ul>${lab}</ul><p>Why: a single random push can move sorting a lot (one draw gives selection sort ${pct(T.cells.rand3_s2.counts.Selection/T.cells.rand3_s2.n)} of programs), so only the mean over draws is a fair baseline.`}));
  } else {
    const c1=T.cells.away_s1, c2=T.cells.away_s2;
    const chk=(ok,txt)=>`<li><span class="${ok?"ok":"no"}">${ok?"Met":"Not met"}</span>: ${txt}</li>`;
    box.append(h("h3",{text:"6. Apply the frozen rule"}),
      io(`The idea distributions at s<sub>1</sub> and s<sub>2</sub> on the main draw (150 programs each) and the frozen predictions.`,
         `Check the three clauses of <button type="button" class="term" data-term="select">SELECT</button>.`,
         `Verdict: <strong>${T.decision.main}</strong> on the main draw, <strong>${T.decision.redraw}</strong> on the redraw.`),
      h("ul",{html:chk(c2.max_nonmode_share>=0.5,`one nonmodal idea takes at least half the programs at s₂: ${fam(c2.max_nonmode_idea)} ${pct(c2.max_nonmode_share)}`)+
        chk(T.predicted_gainers.includes(c2.max_nonmode_idea),`that idea is a predicted gainer (${T.predicted_gainers.map(fam).join(" or ")})`)+
        chk(c2.kl_u>c1.kl_u,`distance from uniform rises again from s₁ to s₂: ${c1.kl_u.toFixed(3)} to ${c2.kl_u.toFixed(3)} bits`)}),
      h("p",{text:"Why: a flattening direction would spread the freed share and lower the distance from uniform; this one gives it to the predicted family."}));
  }
  wireTerms(box); return box;
}
function drawStepSvg(){
  const host=$("step-svg"); host.innerHTML=""; const W=Math.max(300,host.clientWidth||700), n=STAGES.length;
  const small=W<560, H=small?64:74; const sv=s("svg",{viewBox:`0 0 ${W} ${H}`,width:W,height:H,"aria-hidden":"true"});
  const cx=i=>18+i*(W-36)/(n-1);
  s("line",{x1:cx(0),x2:cx(n-1),y1:22,y2:22,stroke:"#cfccc2","stroke-width":3},sv);
  s("line",{x1:cx(0),x2:cx(stage),y1:22,y2:22,stroke:"#1b5a87","stroke-width":3},sv);
  STAGES.forEach(([sh],i)=>{ const on=i===stage, done=i<stage;
    s("circle",{cx:cx(i),cy:22,r:on?13:10,fill:on?"#1b5a87":done?"#8fb1cb":"#fff",stroke:"#1b5a87","stroke-width":2},sv);
    s("text",{x:cx(i),y:26.5,"text-anchor":"middle","font-size":12,"font-weight":700,fill:on?"#fff":"#1b5a87",text:i+1},sv);
    if(!small || on) s("text",{x:Math.min(Math.max(cx(i),40),W-40),y:H-10,"text-anchor":"middle","font-size":12.5,"font-weight":on?700:400,fill:on?"#1b1b1a":"#6b6a64",text:sh},sv);
  });
  host.append(sv);
}
const markers=$("step-markers");
STAGES.forEach(([sh,long],i)=>{ const b=h("button",{type:"button",class:"stagebtn","aria-label":`Stage ${i+1}: ${long}`,text:`${i+1}. ${sh}`}); b.addEventListener("click",()=>goStage(i)); markers.append(h("li",{},b)); });
function goStage(i, announce=true){
  stage=Math.max(0,Math.min(STAGES.length-1,i));
  markers.querySelectorAll("button").forEach((b,j)=>{ if(j===stage) b.setAttribute("aria-current","step"); else b.removeAttribute("aria-current"); });
  $("step-body").innerHTML=""; $("step-body").append(stageBody(stage)); drawStepSvg();
  $("step-prev").disabled=stage===0; $("step-next").disabled=stage===STAGES.length-1;
  $("step-pos").textContent=`Stage ${stage+1} of ${STAGES.length}`;
  if(announce) $("step-live").textContent=`Stage ${stage+1} of ${STAGES.length}: ${STAGES[stage][1]}`;
}
$("step-prev").addEventListener("click",()=>goStage(stage-1));
$("step-next").addEventListener("click",()=>goStage(stage+1));
$("v-step").addEventListener("keydown",e=>{ if(e.target.matches("input,select,textarea,[role=tab],[role=radio]")) return; if(e.key==="ArrowRight"){ e.preventDefault(); goStage(stage+1);} if(e.key==="ArrowLeft"){ e.preventDefault(); goStage(stage-1);} });

/* ================= RANDOM-DRAW VIEW ================= */
const rnd={task:"T2", set:"redraw@s2", metric:"H_mm"};
const SETS=[["main@s1","Away, s<sub>1</sub>"],["redraw@s1","Away, s<sub>1</sub>, redraw"],["main@s2","Away, s<sub>2</sub>"],["redraw@s2","Away, s<sub>2</sub>, redraw"],["off_target@s2","Other task's dir., s<sub>2</sub>"]];
const SETNAME={"main@s1":"the away-from-mode direction at s₁ (main draw)","redraw@s1":"the away-from-mode direction at s₁ (redraw)","main@s2":"the away-from-mode direction at s₂ (main draw)","redraw@s2":"the away-from-mode direction at s₂ (redraw)","off_target@s2":"the other task's direction at s₂"};
const MNAME={H_mm:["Idea entropy, Miller–Madow (bits)","bits"],nonmode_share:["Nonmodal share (fraction of programs)",""],pass:["Pass rate (fraction of programs)",""]};
function baseVal(t,m){ const b=STEER.tasks[t].cells.baseline; if(m==="H_mm") return b.entropy_mm; if(m==="pass") return b.pass_rate; return 1-(b.counts[STEER.tasks[t].mode]||0)/b.n; }
function renderRnd(){
  const t=rnd.task, v=STEER.tasks[t].vs_random[rnd.set][rnd.metric], base=baseVal(t,rnd.metric);
  const host=$("rnd-chart"); host.innerHTML=""; const W=Math.max(300,host.clientWidth||700);
  legend($("rnd-legend"),[["Random draw (5)","#8f8f8f","dot"],["Mean of random draws","#4a4a46","line"],["Targeted setting","#E69F00","dot"],["Unsteered baseline","#1b5a87","dash"]]);
  const rows=["Random draws","Random mean","Targeted"]; const fs=13;
  const ml=Math.max(...rows.map(r=>textW(r,fs)))+14, mr=16, mt=14, rowH=40, axisH=46;
  const vals=[...v.random_per_draw,v.target,v.random_draw_mean,base];
  let lo=Math.min(...vals), hi=Math.max(...vals); const pad=(hi-lo)*0.15||0.1; lo-=pad; hi+=pad;
  if(rnd.metric!=="H_mm"){ lo=Math.max(0,lo); hi=Math.min(1,hi); } else lo=Math.max(0,lo);
  const ticks=niceTicks(lo,hi,5); lo=Math.min(lo,ticks[0]); hi=Math.max(hi,ticks[ticks.length-1]);
  const pw=W-ml-mr, H=mt+rows.length*rowH+axisH, x=q=>ml+(q-lo)/(hi-lo)*pw;
  const sv=s("svg",{viewBox:`0 0 ${W} ${H}`,width:W,height:H,role:"group","aria-label":`Dot plot of ${MNAME[rnd.metric][0]} for five random directions, their mean, the targeted setting and the baseline`});
  ticks.forEach(q=>{ s("line",{x1:x(q),x2:x(q),y1:mt,y2:mt+rows.length*rowH,stroke:"#e4e2da"},sv); s("text",{x:x(q),y:mt+rows.length*rowH+16,"text-anchor":"middle","font-size":12,fill:"#4a4a46",text:(+q.toFixed(3)).toString()},sv); });
  s("text",{x:ml+pw/2,y:H-6,"text-anchor":"middle","font-size":12.5,fill:"#4a4a46",text:MNAME[rnd.metric][0]},sv);
  rows.forEach((r,i)=>s("text",{x:ml-10,y:mt+i*rowH+rowH/2+4.5,"text-anchor":"end","font-size":fs,text:r},sv));
  const bl=s("g",{},sv); s("line",{x1:x(base),x2:x(base),y1:mt-4,y2:mt+rows.length*rowH,stroke:"#1b5a87","stroke-width":2,"stroke-dasharray":"5 4"},bl); s("rect",{class:"hit",x:x(base)-6,y:mt-4,width:12,height:rows.length*rowH+4,fill:"transparent"},bl);
  markify(bl,`Unsteered baseline: ${base.toFixed(3)}`,`<b>Unsteered baseline</b><br>${esc(MNAME[rnd.metric][0])}: ${base.toFixed(3)} (n = ${STEER.tasks[t].cells.baseline.n})`);
  v.random_per_draw.forEach((q,i)=>{ const g=s("g",{},sv); s("circle",{cx:x(q),cy:mt+rowH/2+(i%2?5:-5),r:7,fill:"#8f8f8f",stroke:"#fff","stroke-width":1.5},g); markify(g,`Random draw ${i+1}: ${q.toFixed(3)}`,`<b>Random direction ${i+1}</b><br>${esc(MNAME[rnd.metric][0])}: ${q.toFixed(3)}`); });
  const gm=s("g",{},sv); s("line",{x1:x(v.random_draw_mean),x2:x(v.random_draw_mean),y1:mt+rowH+8,y2:mt+2*rowH-8,stroke:"#4a4a46","stroke-width":4},gm); s("rect",{class:"hit",x:x(v.random_draw_mean)-8,y:mt+rowH+4,width:16,height:rowH-8,fill:"transparent"},gm);
  markify(gm,`Mean of random draws: ${v.random_draw_mean.toFixed(3)}`,`<b>Mean of five random draws</b><br>${v.random_draw_mean.toFixed(3)}`);
  const gt=s("g",{},sv); s("line",{x1:x(v.random_draw_mean),x2:x(v.target),y1:mt+2.5*rowH,y2:mt+2.5*rowH,stroke:"#E69F00","stroke-width":2},gt); s("circle",{cx:x(v.target),cy:mt+2.5*rowH,r:8,fill:"#E69F00",stroke:"#1b1b1a","stroke-width":1},gt);
  markify(gt,`Targeted: ${v.target.toFixed(3)}; difference from random mean ${f2(v.diff)}, 95% CI ${ci2(v.ci)}`,`<b>${esc(SETNAME[rnd.set])}</b><br>${v.target.toFixed(3)}; minus random mean: ${f2(v.diff)}<br>95% CI ${ci2(v.ci)}`);
  host.append(sv);
  const verdict={below:"below the random mean (CI entirely below 0)",beats:"above the random mean (CI entirely above 0)"}[v.verdict]||"not distinguishable from the random mean (CI includes 0)";
  $("rnd-readout").innerHTML=`<div><span class="v">${v.target.toFixed(3)}</span>targeted</div><div><span class="v">${v.random_draw_mean.toFixed(3)}</span>random mean</div><div><span class="v">${sg2(v.diff)}</span>difference</div><div><span class="v">${ci2(v.ci)}</span>95% hierarchical bootstrap CI</div>`;
  let extra="";
  if(rnd.metric==="H_mm"&&v.verdict==="below") extra=" Lower entropy than random pushes of the same norm is the signature of selection.";
  if(rnd.metric==="H_mm"&&t==="T1"&&rnd.set.endsWith("s2")&&!rnd.set.startsWith("off")) extra=" Here entropy alone would read as a diversity gain; switch to nonmodal share and open the finding chart to see one family, A*, take over.";
  $("rnd-take").textContent=`On ${TASKNAME[t]}, ${SETNAME[rnd.set]} is ${verdict} in ${MNAME[rnd.metric][0].toLowerCase()}: ${sg2(v.diff)} ${ci2(v.ci)}.${extra}`;
}
tabs($("rnd-task"),TASKS,rnd.task,v=>{ rnd.task=v; renderRnd(); });
radios($("rnd-set"),SETS,rnd.set,v=>{ rnd.set=v; renderRnd(); });

/* ================= ITEM BROWSER ================= */
const TEXTC=["baseline","away_s1","away_s2","rand0_s2","off_s2"];
const it={task:"T2",a:"baseline",b:"away_s2",filter:"all",q:"",sort:"seed",sel:null};
["it-a","it-b"].forEach(id=>{ const sel=$(id); TEXTC.forEach(k=>sel.append(h("option",{value:k,text:clong(k)}))); });
$("it-a").value=it.a; $("it-b").value=it.b;
const FILTERS=[["all","All"],["changed","Idea changed"],["same","Idea kept"],["bfail","B fails oracle"]];
const itFilter=radios($("it-filter"),FILTERS,it.filter,v=>{ it.filter=v; renderItems(); });
function famMatch(lab,q){ return fam(lab).toLowerCase().includes(q)||String(lab).toLowerCase().includes(q); }
function itRows(){
  const C=ITEMS[it.task].conds, A=C[it.a], B=C[it.b]; const q=it.q.trim().toLowerCase();
  let rows=A.map((a,i)=>({i,a,b:B[i],pre:prefixLen(a.x,B[i].x)}));
  rows=rows.filter(r=> it.filter==="all"||(it.filter==="changed"&&r.a.l!==r.b.l)||(it.filter==="same"&&r.a.l===r.b.l)||(it.filter==="bfail"&&r.b.o!=="pass"));
  if(q) rows=rows.filter(r=>famMatch(r.a.l,q)||famMatch(r.b.l,q));
  if(it.sort==="ntB") rows.sort((x,y)=>y.b.nt-x.b.nt||x.i-y.i); else if(it.sort==="prefix") rows.sort((x,y)=>y.pre-x.pre||x.i-y.i);
  return rows;
}
function chip(o){ return `<span class="chip ${o==="pass"?"pass":"fail"}">${esc(o.replace(/_/g," "))}</span>`; }
function renderItems(){
  const rows=itRows(), list=$("it-list"); list.innerHTML="";
  if(it.sel==null || !rows.some(r=>r.i===it.sel)) it.sel=rows.length?rows[0].i:null;
  rows.forEach(r=>{ const b=h("button",{type:"button","aria-pressed":String(r.i===it.sel)}); b.innerHTML=`<span><span class="sd">Seed ${r.i}</span> ${esc(fam(r.a.l))} → ${esc(fam(r.b.l))}</span>${r.b.o==="pass"?"":'<span class="chip fail">B '+esc(r.b.o.replace(/_/g," "))+"</span>"}`; b.addEventListener("click",()=>{ it.sel=r.i; renderItems(); }); list.append(h("li",{},b)); });
  const C=ITEMS[it.task].conds, n=C[it.a].length; const changed=C[it.a].filter((a,i)=>a.l!==C[it.b][i].l).length;
  $("it-count").textContent=`${rows.length} of ${n} seeds shown. ${changed} of ${n} seeds change idea between the two conditions.`;
  const det=$("it-detail"); det.innerHTML="";
  if(it.sel==null){ det.append(h("p",{text:"No seed matches this filter and search."})); }
  else {
    const a=C[it.a][it.sel], b=C[it.b][it.sel], same=prefixLen(a.x,b.x);
    det.append(h("p",{class:"small",html:`<strong>Prompt:</strong> <em>${esc(ITEMS[it.task].prompt)}</em> · seed ${it.sel} · temperature 0.7. ${same>0?`Grey text is shared by both responses (first ${same} characters).`:"The responses differ from the first character."}`}));
    const col=(k,r,sm)=>h("div",{},h("h4",{text:clong(k)}),h("p",{class:"small",html:`<strong>${esc(fam(r.l))}</strong> · oracle ${chip(r.o)} · pass fraction ${r.p} · ${r.nt} tokens${r.tr?" · hit token cap":""}`}),codeBlock(r.x,sm),h("p",{class:"small muted",text:`First ${r.x.length} of ${r.full} characters.`}));
    det.append(h("div",{class:"side2"},col(it.a,a,same),col(it.b,b,same)));
  }
  const sw={}; C[it.a].forEach((a,i)=>{ const bl=C[it.b][i].l; if(a.l!==bl){ const k=a.l+"→"+bl; sw[k]=(sw[k]||0)+1; } });
  const top=Object.entries(sw).sort((x,y)=>y[1]-x[1])[0];
  const bf=C[it.b].filter(r=>r.o!=="pass").length, af=C[it.a].filter(r=>r.o!=="pass").length;
  $("it-take").textContent=top?`Going from ${clong(it.a)} to ${clong(it.b)} on ${TASKNAME[it.task]}, ${changed} of ${n} seeds change idea, and the most common switch is ${top[0].split("→").map(fam).join(" → ")} (${top[1]} seeds). Oracle failures: ${af} in A, ${bf} in B.`:`The two conditions are identical in label on every seed.`;
}
tabs($("it-task"),TASKS,it.task,v=>{ it.task=v; it.sel=null; renderItems(); });
$("it-a").addEventListener("change",e=>{ it.a=e.target.value; renderItems(); });
$("it-b").addEventListener("change",e=>{ it.b=e.target.value; renderItems(); });

/* ================= BANS ================= */
const ban={task:"T1",cond:"ban_Greedy_best_first"};
function banList(t){ return Object.keys(BANS[t]).filter(k=>k.startsWith("ban_")).sort(); }
function fillBanSel(){ const sel=$("ban-sel"); sel.innerHTML=""; banList(ban.task).forEach(k=>sel.append(h("option",{value:k,text:"Do not use "+fam(k.slice(4))}))); if(!banList(ban.task).includes(ban.cond)) ban.cond=banList(ban.task)[0]; sel.value=ban.cond; }
function renderBan(){
  const t=ban.task, P=BANS[t].placebo, B=BANS[t][ban.cond], banned=ban.cond.slice(4);
  $("ban-prompt").innerHTML=`<strong>Ban prompt:</strong> <em>${esc(B.prompts[0])}</em><br><strong>Placebo prompt:</strong> <em>${esc(P.prompts.join(" / "))}</em> (three placebo blocks pooled, n = ${P.n}).`;
  legend($("ban-legend"),[["Placebo prompt","#a3a3a3"],["With the negative instruction","#1b5a87"],["* significant drop of an unbanned family (Fisher, Holm-corrected)","#a4400a","ring"]]);
  const fams=[...new Set([...Object.keys(P.counts),...Object.keys(B.counts),banned])].sort((x,y)=>((P.counts[y]||0)/P.n+(B.counts[y]||0)/B.n)-((P.counts[x]||0)/P.n+(B.counts[x]||0)/B.n));
  const regc={}; BANS.regularity.cells.filter(c=>c.task===t&&c.cond===ban.cond).forEach(c=>regc[c.idea]=c);
  const host=$("ban-chart"); host.innerHTML=""; const W=Math.max(300,host.clientWidth||700), fs=13;
  const labs=fams.map(f=>fam(f)+(f===banned?" (banned)":"")+(regc[f]&&regc[f].violation?" *":""));
  const ml=Math.max(...labs.map(l=>textW(l,fs)))+14, mr=50, mt=6, bh=13, rowH=bh*2+14, axisH=42;
  const pw=W-ml-mr, H=mt+fams.length*rowH+axisH, x=v=>ml+v*pw;
  const sv=s("svg",{viewBox:`0 0 ${W} ${H}`,width:W,height:H,role:"group","aria-label":"Share of programs per family under the placebo prompt and under the negative instruction"});
  [0,.25,.5,.75,1].forEach(v=>{ s("line",{x1:x(v),x2:x(v),y1:mt,y2:H-axisH+2,stroke:"#e4e2da"},sv); s("text",{x:x(v),y:H-axisH+16,"text-anchor":"middle","font-size":12,fill:"#4a4a46",text:Math.round(v*100)},sv); });
  s("text",{x:ml+pw/2,y:H-6,"text-anchor":"middle","font-size":12.5,fill:"#4a4a46",text:"Share of programs (%)"},sv);
  fams.forEach((f,i)=>{
    const y=mt+i*rowH; const rc=regc[f];
    s("text",{x:ml-10,y:y+bh+5,"text-anchor":"end","font-size":fs,"font-weight":f===banned?700:400,fill:rc&&rc.violation?"#a4400a":"#1b1b1a",text:labs[i]},sv);
    [[P,"#a3a3a3","Placebo prompt",0],[B,"#1b5a87","Negative instruction",1]].forEach(([S,col,nm,j])=>{
      const v=(S.counts[f]||0)/S.n, g=s("g",{},sv), yy=y+j*(bh+2);
      s("rect",{x:ml,y:yy,width:Math.max(v*pw,1),height:bh,fill:col},g);
      s("text",{x:x(v)+4,y:yy+bh-2,"font-size":11.5,fill:"#1b1b1a",text:(v*100).toFixed(1)},g);
      let html=`<b>${esc(fam(f))}</b><br>${nm}: ${(v*100).toFixed(1)}% (${S.counts[f]||0} of ${S.n})`;
      if(rc&&j===1) html+=`<br>Drop from placebo: ${(rc.drop*100).toFixed(1)} points; Holm p = ${rc.p_holm<0.001?rc.p_holm.toExponential(1):rc.p_holm.toFixed(3)}${rc.violation?"; regularity violation":""}`;
      markify(g,`${fam(f)}, ${nm}: ${(v*100).toFixed(1)} percent`,html);
    });
  });
  host.append(sv);

  o.series.forEach((se,si)=>{

    se.vals.forEach((v,i)=>{ if(v==null) return; const g=s("g",{},sv); const hollow=(se.hollow||[]).includes(i);

      else s("circle",{cx:x(i),cy:y(v),r:i===o.cur?7:5,fill:hollow?"#fff":se.col,stroke:hollow?se.col:"#fff","stroke-width":hollow?2:1.5},g);

/* ================= STRENGTH RULE ================= */
const st={task:"T2",bar:0.8};
function applyRule(cal, bar){
  const grid=Object.keys(cal.mode_share_by_alpha).map(Number).sort((a,b)=>a-b);
  const ms=a=>cal.mode_share_by_alpha[String(a)], ps=a=>cal.pass_by_alpha[String(a)];
  const s1=grid.reduce((b,a)=>Math.abs(ms(a)-0.5*cal.baseline_mode_share)<Math.abs(ms(b)-0.5*cal.baseline_mode_share)?a:b);
  const elig=grid.filter(a=>ps(a)>=bar*cal.baseline_pass-1e-12);
  let s2=null; if(elig.length) s2=elig.reduce((b,a)=>(ms(a)<ms(b)||(ms(a)===ms(b)&&a>b))?a:b);
  return {grid,s1,s2,elig};
}
function renderStrength(){

  lineChart($("st-chart"),{xs:keys,xlabels:keys,ylo:0,yhi:1,yTitle:"Fraction of programs",xTitle:"Steering strength α (calibration runs, n = 30 each)",cur:R.grid.indexOf(R.s2),
    aria:"Mode share and pass rate against steering strength in the calibration runs",
    hlines:[{v:st.bar*cal.baseline_pass,col:"#a4400a"}],

            {name:"pass",col:"#1b5a87",vals:keys.map(a=>cal.pass_by_alpha[a]),dash:true,shape:"sq",hollow:R.grid.map((a,i)=>R.elig.includes(a)?-1:i)}],
    tipFor:(si,i)=>{ const a=keys[i], c=cal.cells[a]; const comp=Object.entries(c.counts).sort((x,y)=>y[1]-x[1]).map(([f,n])=>`${fam(f)} ${n}`).join(", ");
      const v=si?cal.pass_by_alpha[a]:cal.mode_share_by_alpha[a]; const nm=si?"Pass rate":`${fam(T.mode)} share`;
      return {label:`α ${a}: ${nm} ${v.toFixed(2)}`,html:`<b>α = ${a}</b> (n = ${c.n})<br>${nm}: ${v.toFixed(2)}<br>${esc(comp)}`}; }});
  const frozen=cal.s2, match=R.s2===frozen;
  const c2=R.s2!=null?cal.cells[String(R.s2)]:null;
  const top=c2?Object.entries(c2.counts).sort((x,y)=>y[1]-x[1])[0]:null;
  $("st-readout").innerHTML=`<div><span class="v">${(st.bar*cal.baseline_pass).toFixed(3)}</span>bar on pass rate (baseline ${cal.baseline_pass.toFixed(3)})</div><div><span class="v">${R.s1}</span>s<sub>1</sub> by the rule</div><div><span class="v">${R.s2==null?"none":R.s2}</span>s<sub>2</sub> by the rule</div><div><span class="v">${frozen}</span>frozen s<sub>2</sub></div>`;
  let txt;
  if(R.s2==null) txt=`No calibrated strength keeps the pass rate above ${(st.bar*cal.baseline_pass).toFixed(3)} on ${TASKNAME[t]}; the frozen rule would then fall back to the smallest α.`;
  else txt=`With the bar at ${st.bar.toFixed(2)} × baseline, the rule picks s₂ = ${R.s2} on ${TASKNAME[t]}${match?", the value that was frozen":`, not the frozen ${frozen}`}. In its 30 calibration programs ${fam(top[0])} takes ${top[1]} of ${c2.n}.`+(match?` At full size (150 programs) that strength gave ${fam(T.cells.away_s2.max_nonmode_idea)} ${pct(T.cells.away_s2.max_nonmode_share)} with pass rate ${T.cells.away_s2.pass_rate.toFixed(2)}${t==="T1"?", below the bar the 30-program calibration had predicted it would meet":""}.`:"");

button[aria-selected=\"true\"],.seg button[aria-pressed=\"true\"],.seg button[aria-checked=\"true\"]{background:var(--accent);color:#fff;font-weight:600}\n.seg{display:inline-flex;border:1px solid rect.hit{stroke:var(--accent);stroke-width:2.5}\n#tip{position:absolute;z-index:80;max-width:300px;background:#1f1f1d;color:#fff;font-size:14px;line-height:1.45;padding:9px 11px;border-radius:6px;pointer-events:none;box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.2);display:none}\n#tip b{color:#fff}\n.readout{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px 26px;margin:10px 0 var(--accent);font-size:15px;line-height:1.5;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:6px;box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.15);display:none}\n#termtip strong{display:block;margin-bottom:2px}\n/* stepper var(--rule);background:#fff;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;color:var(--ink2)}\n.stagebtn[aria-current=\"step\"]{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);color:#fff;font-weight:600}\n.stagebody{border-top:1px .same{color:#8a887f}\n.bars{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr auto;gap:4px 10px;align-items:center;font-size:14px;margin:8px 0}\n.bars */\n.browser{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(220px,300px) minmax(0,1fr);gap:18px;margin-top:10px}\n.itemlist{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;max-height:560px;overflow:auto;border:1px solid var(--rule);border-radius:6px}\n.itemlist button{font:inherit;font-size:14px;width:100%;text-align:left;min-height:44px;padding:7px 10px;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule2);background:#fff;cursor:pointer;color:var(--ink);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px}\n.itemlist button[aria-pressed=\"true\"]{background:var(--accent-soft);box-shadow:inset 4px 0 0 var(--accent)}\n.itemlist .sd{color:var(--muted);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;flex:none}\n.chip{display:inline-block;font-size:13px;padding:1px
